messages:
alex: Quick sync on the authz postmortem follow-up. Root cause appears to be a race between revocation event publish and the edge-proxy's in-memory cache eviction. Small window where revoked tokens validated. Posting proposed actions below, pls pick owners.

priya: thanks alex. can you paste the action list here? i'll triage into the security board and add estimates.

alex: sure. condensed list:
- T1: patch edge-proxy cache invalidation to use versioned keys and immediate invalidation on revocation event (owner: alex, due: 2026-04-02)
- T2: backfill missing audit events for 2026-03-22 02:14-02:22 and confirm downstream index coverage (owner: priya, due: 2026-03-29)
- T3: add metric + alert: "revocations_propagation_latency" (SLO: 30s) and dashboard (owner: noah, due: 2026-03-31)
- T4: create a secrets rotation verification script + publish runbook for KMS/HSM rotations (owner: emily, due: 2026-04-05)
- T5: establish monthly permission-drift scan + reporting (owner: security-team, due: 2026-04-10)

noah: ack T3. i'll add the alert and a Grafana panel. question: should the metric be computed per-region or global? recommend per-region to catch propagation issues.

emily: ack T4. i'll draft the runbook and a small test harness that exercises rotated key unwraps. will include steps for both KMS and HSM flows.

priya: ack T2. i'll need read access to raw auth logs and the kafka topic retention settings. @ops-bot can you open a ticket to grant read-only s3/kafka access for me?

ops-bot: Access ticket created: https://redwood.tools/infra/tickets/54321 - read-only to s3://auth-raw and kafka topic auth-events granted for priya (expires 2026-03-31). Postmortem: https://redwood.company/pm/incident-2026-03-22/overview

alex: small mitigation note: adding a short-lived token flag (30s) for admin sessions reduced blast radius in canary. we should consider defaulting short-exp tokens for high-priv ops. add as a follow-on if T1 lands.

noah: good call. i'll include a simulation in the alerting runbook to show how short-lived tokens change propagation risk.

emily: for rotation verification, i'll add a CI job that runs after rotation to decrypt a test payload with newly rotated keys. quick snippet:
```bash
# verify rotated key unwrap
curl -s -X POST https://auth.redwood.internal/v0/keys/verify -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" -d '{"ciphertext":"..."}'
```

priya: timeline check: can T2 and T3 be done before next deploy window on Fri 2026-03-27? having metrics before deploy would be ideal.

alex: T1 is higher risk and might slip to Mon 2026-04-02, but i'll try to get a small hotfix in earlier if needed.

noah: I can land T3 by Thu 2026-03-26 if priya confirms access to logs for calculating baseline propagation times.

priya: confirmed access. i'll start the backfill tomorrow and share a short script to validate indexes.

emily: i'll block off time for T4 and aim for the runbook draft by Mon 2026-04-06.

alex: i've created the board cards and linked them to the postmortem, labeled security/remediation/critical. https://redwood.tools/boards/pm-54321

ops-bot: Reminder: postmortem owners must file closure notes when tasks complete. Use label `pm:remediated` to auto-close.

noah: one more ask 55 - can we add a recurring weekly digest to #security with revocation propagation stats? would help surface regressions early.

alex: agreed. adding weekly digest to the checklist. thanks all for quick acks. ping here if blocked.

priya: ack :+1:

emily: ack

noah: ack
